title: Quasi-equivalence of relabeled positroid cluster structures
summary: We prove the Fraser--Sherman-Bennett conjecture on the quasi-equivalence of positroid cluster structures arising from admissibly relabeled plabic graphs. We construct a tilting module from the boundary necklace and obtain a Frobenius categorification of the relabeled cluster structure. By identifying localized characters of rank-one modules with Plücker coordinates, we match the stable images of the mutable face modules with the summands of a reachable cluster-tilting object in the stable category. The induced derived equivalence yields a unimodular transformation of relative index lattices…
